purpose: Independent Simulator React UI; demo preview or Sensor Control API baseline1.3.2.
boundaries: Demo browser preview is explicit and never publishes readings or commands to live services.
Live calls only the five frozen Sensor Control operations; no Business proxy or Kafka credentials.
Sensor provider is implemented separately in sensor/; browser integration uses fixture ingestion and explicit loopback auth.
Independent image/config; Kubernetes manifests and platform releases remain in GitOps.
